conversation: A: I am organizing accompany picnic for this Saturday, can you come?
B: I would love to but I am not sure that I can. I think I am supposed to work overtime.
A: That's a shame, is there any chance you can possibly get out of working over time?
B: I am not sure; I will check it and let you know.

A: It nice of you to say that, I am doing my best.
